abstract: A clinicopathologic study was undertaken on 504 ovarian tumors which were treated in Osaka University Hospital during the past 18 years period. Also, marker substances were examined with some tumors. Most of the ovarian tumors were benign and cystic; 191 dermoid cysts, 106 serous cystadenomas, and 68 mucinous cystadenomas. Among the intermediate and malignant tumor groups, common epithelial tumors were the commonest and seen in older ages. Androblastomas, a granulosa cell tumor arising in dermoid cyst, and a possible juvenile granulosa cell tumor were rarely seen. Dysgerminomas and embryonal carcinomas were fairly popular in young ages. Malignant changes of dermoid cyst were rare and in older ages; the include an insular carcinoid, a strumal carcinoid, squamous cell carcinomas, an adenocarcinoma, and a malignant fibrous histiocytoma. Ovarian tumors in pregnancy were mostly dermoid cyst and fibroma. Bilaterality was more frequent in malignant tumors (20%) than others. The serum levels of marker substances have recently been utilized for the diagnosis, treatment and follow-up studies. Immunohistology was useful for the classification of some tumors. Radical operation and chemotherapy were chosen for the treatment of malignant ovarian tumors except some low grade malignancies, but the prognoses were generally poor.
abstract_ja: 過去18年間に大阪大学病院で治療された卵巣腫瘍504例について臨床病理学的検討を行った。一部の腫瘍では腫瘍マーカーも検討した。卵巣腫瘍の大部分は良性の嚢胞性腫瘍であり、類皮嚢腫191例、漿液性嚢胞腺腫106例、粘液性嚢胞腺腫68例であった。中間悪性群および悪性腫瘍群では、上皮性腫瘍が最も多く、高齢者に多くみられた。アンドロブラストーマ、類皮嚢腫に生じた顆粒膜細胞腫、および若年性顆粒膜細胞腫の可能性がある症例はまれであった。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）および胎児性癌は若年者に比較的多くみられた。類皮嚢腫の悪性化はまれで、高齢者にみられ、島状カルチノイド、甲状腺腫様カルチノイド、扁平上皮癌、腺癌、悪性線維性組織球腫が含まれた。妊娠中の卵巣腫瘍は大部分が類皮嚢腫と線維腫であった。両側性は悪性腫瘍で他の腫瘍より多く（20%）みられた。腫瘍マーカーの血清値は近年、診断、治療、フォローアップの検討に用いられている。免疫組織化学は一部の腫瘍の分類に有用であった。低悪性度の一部を除き、悪性卵巣腫瘍に対しては根治的手術と化学療法が選択されたが、予後は概して不良であった。
